message:
🎉 PichiTV v2.5.1 is here!

✨ Key Updates & Bug Fixes:
• 🎬 Recreated Movie Details Screen — Brand-new responsive layout with top navigation, back button, live clock, dynamic metadata badges, formatted synopsis, and action controls.
• 🦋 Smart Ambient Companions — Living creatures with focus curiosity, touch/tap reactions, and natural resting cycles across all screens.
• 🎯 Zero-Clipping Focus & Hover — Refined 1.02x focus scaling and unclipped containers in Settings so borders and edges never get cut off.
• 📺 Smart Persistent Player Logo — Continuous, elegant broadcast watermark across Live TV, Movie, and OTT players (subtle on video, bright on HUD, auto-hidden in PiP).
• ⚡ Performance & UI Polish — Smooth navigation, bug fixes, and enhanced responsiveness on all TV and mobile screens.

Enjoy the upgraded PichiTV experience! 🍿
